# Mimo

> > Mimo is an interactive coding education platform offering career paths and courses in Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, TypeScript, SQL, and Swift for beginners and aspiring developers.

Mimo provides mobile-first coding education with hands-on projects, portfolio building opportunities, and comprehensive glossaries covering web development, back-end programming, and modern frameworks. The platform serves as a coding bootcamp alternative with beginner-friendly career paths in front-end and back-end development.

## Key Topics

- Python Development
- Front-End Development
- JavaScript & TypeScript
- HTML & CSS
- React & JSX
- Back-End Development
- SQL & Databases
- API Development
- Asynchronous Programming
- DOM Manipulation
- Career Paths
- Portfolio Projects
- Web Development Concepts
- NodeJS & Express
- Programming Fundamentals

## Career Path Courses

- [Learn Front-End Development | HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and more](https://mimo.org/courses/front-end-development): Front-End Development career path covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React
- [Learn Python Development and Build Robust Applications](https://mimo.org/courses/python-development): Python Development career path course with API and portfolio projects

## Programming Concepts & Fundamentals

- [Null, Undefined, and None: Definition, Purpose, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/programming-concepts/null-undefined-none): Cross-language reference for handling null, undefined, and None values
- [Exception / Error Handling: Definition, Purpose, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/programming-concepts/exception-handling): Exception handling reference with try-catch patterns across languages
- [Comment: Definition, Purpose, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/programming-concepts/comment): Code comments reference across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and more

## JavaScript & TypeScript Reference

- [What is TypeScript: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/typescript): TypeScript language reference covering static typing and compilation
- [JavaScript Callback Function: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/javascript/callback-function): JavaScript callback function reference with async handling examples
- [TypeScript Map Type: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/typescript/map-type): TypeScript mapped types reference for transforming object properties

## React Framework Reference

- [React Events: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/react/events): React event handling reference covering synthetic events and interactions
- [React Portal: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/react/portal): React Portal reference for rendering components outside parent DOM

## HTML & CSS Reference

- [CSS Grid Layout: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/css/grid-layout): CSS Grid Layout reference for responsive two-dimensional layouts
- [CSS Position Absolute: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/css/position-absolute): CSS position absolute reference for precise element placement
- [HTML Superscript: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/html/superscript): HTML <sup> tag reference for superscript text formatting

## Career Guides & Learning Resources

- [Front-End vs Back-End: Key Differences](https://mimo.org/blog/front-end-vs-back-end-development): Career comparison guide for front-end vs back-end development paths
- [The Ultimate Beginner's Guide to Back-End Development](https://mimo.org/blog/back-end-development): Beginner's guide to back-end development careers and server-side skills
- [Our 12 Favorite Online Python Courses with Certificates (2026)](https://mimo.org/blog/best-python-online-courses-with-certificates): Comparison of top Python courses with certificates from Mimo and others
- [11 Best Free HTML Courses for Beginners (2025)](https://mimo.org/blog/best-free-html-courses): Comparison of best free HTML5 courses including Mimo and FreeCodeCamp
- [AI vs Traditional Programming: How Coding Is Changing in 2026](https://mimo.org/blog/ai-vs-traditional-programming): Blog post comparing AI-assisted coding with traditional programming in 2026

## Optional Reference Pages

- [SQL Constraints: Syntax, Usage, and Examples](https://mimo.org/glossary/sql/constraints): SQL constraints reference covering PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE, and CHECK
- [False Values in Python: Unveiling True and False](https://mimo.org/glossary/python/value-false): Python boolean values reference covering True, False, and falsy values
